title: 第23章 柳长风第24章 刘家严阵以待
slug: 高武这个和尚太能装了
content_zh:
;;
真玄坐在窗边，目光透过窗棂，望向楼下的街景。
灯火阑珊处，人来人往，热闹非凡。
他端起茶杯，轻轻抿了一口，心中却在想的是最近毫无头绪的事情。
就在这时，楼梯口传来一阵沉稳的脚步声，像是一个内力深厚的高手在刻意收敛。
真玄的目光微微一动，转头看向楼梯口。
一个身材高大的男子走了上来。
那男子看上去约莫四十出头，剑眉星目，面容棱角分明，一头黑发随意地束在脑后，几缕碎发垂在额前，平添了几分潇洒不羁。
他穿着一件月白色的长衫，腰间悬着一柄长剑，剑鞘通体乌黑，上面没有任何装饰，却透着一股古朴厚重的气息。
他的目光明亮而锐利，扫过二楼雅间时，在真玄身上停了一停，又落在真玄身前的饭桌上。
桌上摆着几碟素菜，还有一盘切得薄薄的酱妖牛肉。
这僧人吃肉喝酒，悠然自得，半点没有出家人常有的拘谨。
柳长风嘴角浮起一丝笑意。
他来到这云州以后，便听过不少关于这位真玄大师的传闻。
有人说他心狠手辣，也有人说他不守清规的，还有人说他曾经气得真如寺持戒堂首座想撂挑子。
这些传闻，柳长风听过便罢，并未放在心上。
江湖上的事，真真假假，谁说得清呢？
但今日在醉仙楼偶遇，他远远地看着对方，忽然生出一个念头：这个人，活得真痛快。
想喝酒就喝酒，想吃肉就吃肉，想杀人就杀人，哪怕有门规戒律压着，哪怕有同门师兄弟盯着，他照样我行我素。
宁愿受罚，也不愿委屈了自己的本心。

柳长风羡慕这样的人。
他自己也是个洒脱的性子，不喜欢被束缚，所以才做了散修，不入任何宗门。
可真玄不同。
真玄身在禅宗名门，头上压着方丈、首座、戒律堂，身下迎着上千僧众的目光。
在这样的环境里，还能活得如此随心所欲，那才是真正的本事。
柳长风觉得这个人很有意思，于是整了整衣襟，笑着大步朝对面走去。
他的笑容很真诚，没有半分虚伪做作，就像一个久别重逢的老友，忽然在街头再次相遇。
“这位大师，”那男子大步走了过来，抱拳道，“在下冒昧，敢问大师可是真如寺破妄禅院首座，真玄大师？”
真玄站起身，双手合十：“贫僧正是真玄。施主是......”
那男子哈哈一笑，道：
“在下柳长风，江湖上一个无名小卒，四处游历的散修罢了。
今日在醉仙楼用饭，见大师气度不凡，便斗胆过来问一声。
若是在下认错了人，还请大师恕罪。”
真玄打量着面前的男子。
柳长风。
这个名字他从未听说过，但这个人，绝对不是什么无名小卒。
真玄是抱丹期的高手，虽然刻意收敛了气息，但对周围人的感知，远比常人敏锐得多。
他能清晰地感受到，柳长风体内那股浑厚而凝练的修为，如同深潭中的暗流，表面波澜不惊，底下却蕴藏着惊人的力量。
至少是化劲圆满，有且有可能是抱丹老怪。
而且这个人带着一股凌厉的剑意，就像一柄藏在鞘中的利剑，随时都可能出鞘。

真玄心中微微一动，面上却不动声色，道：“柳施主客气了。请坐。”
柳长风也不客气，一屁股坐在了真玄对面，将长剑解下，靠在桌边。
他看了真玄一眼，笑道：“大师，在下有个不情之请，不知当讲不当讲。”
“柳施主请说。”。
“在下想请大师喝杯酒，交个朋友。”

Zhenxuan sat by the window, looking through the window lattice at the street scene downstairs.
The dimly lit place was bustling with people coming and going.
He picked up the teacup and took a sip, but what he was thinking about was something he had no clue about recently.
At this moment, there was a steady sound of footsteps at the top of the stairs, as if a master with deep inner strength was deliberately restraining himself.
Zhenxuan's eyes moved slightly and he turned to look at the stairs.
A tall man walked up.
The man looked to be in his early forties, with sword-shaped eyebrows and starry eyes, and an angular face. His black hair was tied back casually, with a few strands of broken hair hanging in front of his forehead, adding a bit of unrestrained style.
He was wearing a moon-white gown, with a long sword hanging from his waist. The scabbard was completely black, with no decorations on it, but it exuded a simple and heavy atmosphere.
His eyes were bright and sharp. When he swept across the private room on the second floor, he stopped for a moment on Zhenxuan, and then landed on the dining table in front of Zhenxuan.
There were several dishes of vegetarian dishes on the table, as well as a plate of thinly sliced ​​beef with soy sauce.
The monk ate meat and drank alcohol in a leisurely manner, without any of the formality that monks often have.
A smile appeared on Liu Changfeng's lips.
After he came to Yunzhou, he heard a lot of rumors about this Master Zhenxuan.
Some said he was ruthless, others said he was unruly, and some said he was once so angry that the head of the temple's ordination hall wanted to quit.
Liu Changfeng just heard these rumors and didn't take them to heart.
Who can tell whether things in the arena are true or false?
But today, when he met each other by chance in Zuixian Tower, he looked at the other person from a distance and suddenly had a thought: This person lived a really happy life.
He drinks when he wants, eats meat when he wants, kills when he wants, even if there are rules and regulations in the sect, even if his fellow disciples are watching, he still goes his own way.
I would rather be punished than wrong my true heart.
Liu Changfeng envied such people.
He himself has a free and easy temperament and does not like to be restrained, so he became a casual cultivator and did not join any sect.
But Zhenxuan is different.
Zhenxuan was in a famous Zen sect, with the abbot, the first seat, and the precepts hall on his head, and facing the gazes of thousands of monks below him.
In such an environment, being able to live as one pleases is the real skill.
Liu Changfeng thought this person was very interesting, so he straightened his clothes, smiled and strode towards the opposite side.
His smile was sincere, without any pretense, like an old friend reunited after a long separation and suddenly meeting again on the street.
"This master," the man strode over and said with his fists clasped, "I'd like to take the liberty of asking if this master is the head of Powang Zen Temple in Zhenru Temple, Master Zhenxuan?"
Zhenxuan stood up and clasped his hands together: "The poor monk is Zhenxuan. The donor is..."
The man laughed and said:
"I am Liu Changfeng, a nobody in the world, just a wandering cultivator.
Today I was having dinner at Zuixian Tower. Seeing the master's extraordinary bearing, I boldly came over and asked.
If I have admitted the wrong person, please forgive me, Master. "
Zhenxuan looked at the man in front of him.
Liu Changfeng.
He had never heard of this name, but this man was definitely not a nobody.
Zhenxuan is a master in the Dan Bao stage. Although he deliberately restrains his aura, his perception of the people around him is much sharper than ordinary people.
He could clearly feel that the rich and condensed cultivation in Liu Changfeng's body was like the undercurrent in a deep pool. It was calm on the surface, but contained astonishing power underneath.
At least it's a perfect transformation, and it's possible that it's an old monster holding pills.
Moreover, this man carries a fierce sword intent, like a sharp sword hidden in a sheath that may be unsheathed at any time.
Zhenxuan's heart moved slightly, but his face remained calm as he said, "Donor Liu, you're welcome. Please sit down."
Liu Changfeng was not polite and sat down opposite Zhenxuan. He took off his long sword and leaned against the table.
He glanced at Zhenxuan and said with a smile: "Master, I have an unkind request, I don’t know whether to say it or not. "
"Donor Liu, please tell me. ".
"I would like to invite Master to have a drink and make friends. "
